propositions: Sidecar corpus enumeration must recover both tree-present and git-history-deleted REVIEW_RESULT files from multiple store roots, retaining schema version and model metadata without reimplementing git-log filtering.

Reviewed material reconstruction requires replaying CREATE/EDIT events up to sidecar timestamp, resolving child pins, and rebuilding full PlanContext with conditional file_impact_scope to match the signer's fingerprint computation exactly.

Fingerprint verification must try a candidate set of four legacy normalization modes (current, pre-checkbox, post-checkbox pre-whitespace, post-whitespace pre-reason) and mark verified only if any candidate matches, falling back to SNAPSHOT when no CREATE event exists.

Manifest output must be deterministic across rebuilds via stable row ordering and sorted-key JSON serialization, with per-store counts, verdict/schema histograms, and verification coverage by candidate.
The builder must make no LLM calls, require no network beyond local git, and emit JSONL corpus rows sorted by stable key (store root, ticket_id, sidecar timestamp).
